summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Live Queue & Wait Time Display system. All 7 backend endpoints working correctly. Frontend /queue page and Staff Dashboard Live Queue widget both functional.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: All public endpoints (status, position, busy-hours) correctly work without auth
Backend: Staff endpoints (analytics, call-next, complete) properly require Bearer token auth
Backend: Remote check-in validates appointment existence and phone number match
Backend: Busy hours heatmap correctly aggregates historical data by day/hour
Frontend: Queue page has clinic selector (Pushpa/Amnion) working correctly
Frontend: Stats cards (Being Served, Waiting, Avg Wait, Est. Queue Time) display correctly
Frontend: Check My Position and Remote Check-in forms present and functional
Frontend: Staff Dashboard Live Queue widget shows real-time stats with Call Next and Manage Queue buttons
seed_data_creation: None - tested with existing data (queue currently empty)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live Queue system fully tested. Public endpoints: GET /api/live-queue/status/{clinic}, GET /api/live-queue/position, GET /api/live-queue/busy-hours/{clinic}, POST /api/live-queue/remote-checkin. Staff endpoints (require auth): POST /api/live-queue/staff/call-next/{clinic}, POST /api/live-queue/staff/complete/{appointment_id}, GET /api/live-queue/staff/analytics/{clinic}. Frontend pages: /queue (public queue display), Staff Dashboard has Live Queue widget.

queue_position_lookup.error_handling: Returns 400 if no params, 404 if not found

remote_checkin.validation: Validates appointment exists and phone matches

staff_call_next.behavior: Returns next patient or 'No patients waiting' message
